ownership.source: Typed scalar counts separate display, observation, recording and page-run. Bound128 abortable page-run leases; managed Agent input owns temporary activity. Bootstrap drops unowned external clock. Stream demand activates encoding; page-run alone advances RAF with zero encoding.

ownership.freshness: Ticket fences Source pageEpoch,viewportVersion,inputSeq,captureOrdinal and current Broker serial. Pre-request in-flight/cached captures skipped;observation target change closes1012;recording spans navigation/resize.
ownership.dataPath: Native resources/scene stay on Rust data plane. Source orchestration map arguments carry no SKP and map results have scene:null plus length-only descriptors. Verifier WS consumers intentionally receive/render resources in their own test functions; not a claim of zero resources in the combined verifier process.
ownership.wake: A0→positive encoding transition primes one real BeginFrame ACK before native registration and input/ordinal sampling. Cancellation drains the ACK without encoding. Existing per-capture registration ACK ordering and2s refusal window retained.
